name: egg-hatch
purpose: Carry your Brainstem as one rapp/1 egg: hatch it on your computer, wake the same egg inside any AI that runs Python, and bring the chat and its memory home.

hatch_app.py.purpose: The app: one page on this computer to hatch an egg, take it to any AI, bring the chat and its memory home.

lay_egg.py.purpose: Makes a wake egg from a packed Brainstem, verified before it is written.

skill.md.purpose: Inside every egg: how any AI wakes the Brainstem, talks through it, sends it home, and uses rapp/1.

rapp1.py.purpose: The rapp/1 reference implementation, vendored verbatim (commit 591e014a).

test_egg_hatch.py.purpose: The egg check: good egg passes, changed or empty egg is refused.

README.md.purpose: What it is and the three steps.

install.notes: python3 hatch_app.py (stdlib only). Make an egg: python3 lay_egg.py <your.brainstem.py> <login> <name>.
